meaning: Path-dependent static-coordinate clock displacements conditional on already saved SPA instants; not independent event algorithms, causal identification, or a calendar-accuracy contest

endpointFailureSummary.selectionStatus: The single exception is already blocked by the local selected-event ordering policy and excluded from attribution.

limitations: All controls condition their sampling instants on existing SPA model roots; they are not independently solved continuous counterfactual algorithms.
Clock displacements depend on the declared path; absolute component magnitudes do not add.
Endpoint checks establish algebra/wiring consistency, not independent astronomical observation.
Unavailable roots, inadmissible mixed controls, policy-blocked fields and the one endpoint failure remain in planned denominators.
No calendar was read or scored, no source was acquired, no personal GPS was used and no parameter was fitted.
Topocentric, terrain, observer-height and variable-refraction differences are absent from both current endpoints, not proven physically irrelevant.
This provides no new replacement candidate; earlier full continuous Asr and alternative ephemeris/sampling candidates were rejected.

independentVerification.scope: Recomputes static-cell arithmetic from retained coordinate samples, endpoint classification and telescoping. Does not independently recompute the ephemeris samples, verify sky observations or rescore original calendars.
